mapper.sql: select r.*, coalesce(nullif(c.name, ''), c.username) as collector_name, c.phone as collector_phone, c.location_lat as collector_lat, c.location_lng as collector_lng from recycle_order r left join collector c on r.collector_id = c.id
mapper.insert: insert into recycle_order ( order_no, user_id, collector_id, preferred_collector_id, address_id, address_detail, community, address_lat, address_lng, building_type, floor, contact_name, contact_phone, appliance_type_id, appliance_type_name, appliance_desc, appliance_imgs,brand_level, usage_years, functional_status, appearance_level, condition_factor, price_estimate, estimated_weight, expect_date, expect_time_start, expect_time_end, urgency_level, assign_type, status, points_earned, create_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{collectorId}, #{preferredCollectorId}, #{addressId}, #{addressDetail}, #{community}, #{addressLat}, #{addressLng}, #{buildingType}, #{floor}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{applianceTypeId}, #{applianceTypeName}, #{applianceDesc}, #{applianceImgs},#{brandLevel}, #{usageYears}, #{functionalStatus}, #{appearanceLevel}, #{conditionFactor}, #{priceEstimate}, #{estimatedWeight}, #{expectDate}, #{expectTimeStart}, #{expectTimeEnd}, #{urgencyLevel}, #{assignType}, #{status}, #{pointsEarned}, now())
mapper.select: where r.user_id = #{userId} order by r.create_time desc
where r.collector_id = #{collectorId} order by r.create_time desc
where r.status = #{status} order by r.create_time asc
select avg(user_rating) from recycle_order where collector_id = #{collectorId} and user_rating is not null
select count(*) from recycle_order where date(create_time) = curdate()
select count(*) from recycle_order where status = #{status}
select coalesce(sum(weight_actual), 0) from recycle_order where status = 4
select coalesce(sum(carbon_saved), 0) from recycle_order where status = 4

select coalesce(nullif(r.appliance_type_name, ''), a.name, concat('品类', r.appliance_type_id)) as name, count(*) as count, sum(r.weight_actual) as weight from recycle_order r left join appliance_type a on r.appliance_type_id = a.id where r.status = 4 group by r.appliance_type_id, r.appliance_type_name, a.name

select c.id, coalesce(nullif(c.name, ''), c.username, concat('回收员', c.id)) as name, count(*) as orderCount, sum(r.price_actual) as totalAmount from recycle_order r join collector c on r.collector_id = c.id where r.status = 4 group by r.collector_id, c.id, c.name, c.username order by orderCount desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update recycle_order set status = 1, collector_id = #{collectorId}, assign_type = 3, assign_time = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{oldVersion} and status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(price_actual), 0) AS income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(price_actual), 0) FROM recycle_order WHERE collector_id = #{collectorId} AND status = 4) AS totalIncome FROM recycle_order WHERE collector_id = #{collectorId} AND status = 4 AND DATE_FORMAT(complete_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(complete_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(weight_actual), 0) AS totalWeight, COALESCE(AVG(user_rating), 5) AS avgRating, COALESCE(SUM(price_actual), 0) AS income FROM recycle_order WHERE collector_id = #{collectorId} AND status = 4 AND complete_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(complete_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date DESC
